intro: If you are in Nakhon Phanom and want a quiet, brand-new room with an infinity pool to sit and watch the Mekong and the Lao mountains with nothing in the way — NAKA-RAJ Escape Hotel is a 4-star boutique hotel opened in 2024 on the Mekong riverside in At Samat sub-district, Mueang Nakhon Phanom · just 17 rooms from Deluxe up to a roughly 100sqm Penthouse Suite, many with their own kitchenette · from approx. ฿3,300/night, scored 9.0 from Trip.com reviews and 5.0/5 on TripAdvisor · the trade-off is a location well outside town, so you really want a car or a budget for taxis

body.html: NAKA-RAJ Escape is a small 17-room boutique hotel that opened in 2024, sitting right on the Mekong in At Samat sub-district just south of central Nakhon Phanom · what gets it talked about is not its size or name but the wide-open Mekong view across to the Lao mountains and an infinity pool that looks as if its water spills straight into the river · this is a slow-life stay that guests describe as somewhere they came to recharge rather than to sightsee in town.

Rooms come in several tiers, from Deluxe and Junior Suite to Suite and a Penthouse Suite of around 100sqm · they are freshly furnished in warm tones, with walk-in showers, and many include a small kitchenette with a fridge and microwave — something you rarely find in an up-country hotel · reviews agree the rooms are very clean, the beds comfortable, the soundproofing good, and that many open straight onto a full Mekong view · the two-bedroom suites suit families or groups of friends who want to stay together.
"Spotless room and a beautiful Mekong view — we sat on the balcony looking across to Laos all day. The perfect place to relax, and the staff looked after us so warmly."

The star here is the riverside infinity pool · floating in it while you look across the river to the Lao mountains is what guests mention most, especially at dawn when mist drifts over the water and in the evening when the light turns gold · there is a free fitness room, a riverside garden, and a restaurant/cafe on site, with breakfast served in-room or by the pool on some days · parking and Wi-Fi are free, and with so few rooms set away from town the atmosphere is genuinely peaceful.

Service is another thing reviews praise · the staff are attentive and friendly, looking after guests the way a small hotel that remembers your face does · one international guest stayed several nights in a two-bedroom suite and found almost nothing to fault · because the place is brand new everything still feels fresh and well kept · it suits couples, small families or anyone who wants to escape the noise and spend a couple of quiet nights by the river.

To be honest there are a few things to know before booking · the biggest is that the location is a fair way out of town, in At Samat sub-district, around 15 minutes by car from the riverside walking street and the town's restaurants · one international review notes the hotel uses a taxi service that is fairly expensive, so without your own car getting around takes effort and adds cost · dining options nearby are limited, and the cafe next door drew only an average verdict in some reviews · the pool is small with just a few sunbeds, so at busy times you may have to take turns.

A tip from following the reviews here: ask for a room that faces straight onto the Mekong and has a balcony, because the view is the whole point of this stay · if you are travelling as a family or group, look at a suite with a kitchenette so you can make coffee or warm up food yourselves, since there is little around · and if you are not driving, budget for taxis into town in advance, or rent a car or scooter, which is both handier and cheaper.

Overall NAKA-RAJ Escape plays a different game from the city hotels in Nakhon Phanom — this is a tiny riverside boutique selling quiet, new rooms and the view of the river and infinity pool, not a base you can walk out of to eat and explore the town · the 9.0 Trip.com score and 5.0/5 on TripAdvisor reflect how much guests love the calm and the view, while the criticism is about the distance and the taxi cost · if you are here to relax by the Mekong and have a car, or do not mind the distance, it offers an atmosphere that is hard to find in Nakhon Phanom.

honestSummary: NAKA-RAJ Escape is best for anyone who wants to relax by the Mekong in a quiet, brand-new room with an infinity pool and lovely views across to Laos — clean rooms, caring staff, ideal for couples and small families · but understand that the location is outside town in At Samat sub-district, well away from the riverside walking street and the town's restaurants, you need to budget for taxis without a car, and dining options nearby are limited.
honestChecks: If you want to stroll the riverside walking street and town restaurants easily — this is around 15 minutes' drive out of town → choose a stay along Sunthon Wijit Road in the centre if walking around is your priority
If you are not driving yourself — you will depend on a taxi service reviews call fairly expensive → budget for trips into town in advance, or rent a car or scooter for more freedom
If you expect restaurants and full facilities on the doorstep — this is a small boutique with limited dining nearby → pick a room with a kitchenette to warm up your own food and plan meals ahead

faqTitle: FAQ — NAKA-RAJ Escape Hotel Nakhon Phanom

faq.q: Where is NAKA-RAJ Escape Hotel and is it convenient for sightseeing?
faq.a: It sits at 171 Moo 2, At Samat sub-district, Mueang Nakhon Phanom, right on the Mekong · around 10 minutes' drive from the Thai-Lao Friendship Bridge and about 15 minutes from the riverside walking street and the Naga statue in town · it is an out-of-town stay best suited to those with their own car or who do not mind the distance; without a car you should budget for taxis.

faq.q: What kind of hotel is NAKA-RAJ Escape and how many rooms does it have?
faq.a: It is a 4-star boutique hotel opened in 2024 with 17 rooms on the Mekong riverside · rooms range across Deluxe, Junior Suite, Suite and Penthouse Suite up to around 100sqm, many with a kitchenette, fridge and microwave · there is a riverside infinity pool, free fitness room, garden, restaurant/cafe, free parking and Wi-Fi · it is a quiet riverside retreat rather than a city hotel.

faq.q: How much does NAKA-RAJ Escape cost and what rooms are available?
faq.a: Prices start from approx. ฿3,300/night for a Deluxe room · the Junior Suite is around ฿4,200, the two-bedroom Suite around ฿5,500 and the Penthouse Suite around ฿7,500 · rates vary by season and long weekends, so always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does NAKA-RAJ Escape have a pool and Mekong views?
faq.a: Yes · a riverside infinity pool that looks across to the Lao mountains is what reviews mention most, lovely at misty dawn and golden dusk · many rooms open onto a full river view · the pool is small with only a few sunbeds, so swim at dawn or dusk for the best view and no waiting.

faq.q: Who is NAKA-RAJ Escape best for?
faq.a: It is best for couples, small families or anyone who wants a private riverside escape on the Mekong in a new room with a pool and a fine view · it suits guests with a car or who do not mind the trip into town · if you want a central stay where you can walk to the walking street and restaurants, this may not be the one.

faq.q: Do I need a car at NAKA-RAJ Escape and how do I get into town?
faq.a: It is best to have your own car or rent a car or scooter, as the hotel is in At Samat sub-district, around 15 minutes from town and the riverside · one international review notes the hotel's taxi service is fairly expensive · if you plan to go into town often, budget for transport or arrange a vehicle in advance for both convenience and savings.
